toegepas.voor: koorlede hardop in die klas voorgelees
toegepas.rede_vinder: Voorlees already means reading aloud to others, so hardop is redundant.
toegepas.fout: Pleonasm: 'voorlees' already means reading aloud so others hear, so 'hardop' repeats it.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Removing the redundant 'hardop' tightens the sentence without changing who reads what to whom, and no protected word is touched.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: en syne het spinasie en wortels in.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: en in sy klas s'n groei spinasie en wortels.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'syne het ... in' is loose and colloquial, and 'syne' reads as Sipho's own bed rather than his class's.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'syne het spinasie en wortels in' is natural spoken Afrikaans in a story, the proposal 'sy klas s'n' is clumsier, and it breaks the link with 'sy bedding' later in the story.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: nie een keer in die rede geval nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The idiom is 'in die rede val'; 'ingeval' on its own reads as the conjunction 'in case'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'inval' is a standard verb for interrupting a speaker, and the proposed 'in die rede geval' lacks the object it needs ('haar'), so it is not an improvement.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: of Thandi ná skool sy bedding kom kyk
laat_vaar_vorige.na: of Thandi ná skool sy bedding wil kom kyk
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Reported invitation needs 'wil' to read naturally as a question about her wish.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'gevra of Thandi ... kom kyk' is natural reported speech, and adding 'wil' shifts the question from an invitation to her wish without fixing a fault.
